```sql
SELECT AVG(t.Price) 
FROM main."transactions_1k" t
JOIN main."customers" c ON t."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"
JOIN main."gasstations" g ON t."GasStationID" = g."GasStationID"
WHERE c."Currency" = 'EUR'
  AND g."Segment" = 'LAM'
  AND t."Date" >= DATE '2012-08-23'
  AND t."Date" <= DATE '2012-08-26'
```
